description.narrative: In 2024, BRC will provide bilateral support to the Ukrainian Red Cross Society (URCS). Sector-wise, BRC’s support will focus on International Humanitarian Law (IHL) and Humanitarian Diplomacy (HD), Home-Based Care (HBC) services for older people and people with reduced mobility, health in emergencies – including Mobile Health Units (MHUs), physical and psychosocial rehabilitation, Mental Health and Psycho-Social Support (MHPSS) –, Restoring Family Links (RFL), and basic needs, including for seasonal shocks such as winterization. Cash and Voucher Assistance (CVA) will be used as a modality to achieve outcomes under these sectors. In alignment with BRC’s commitment to support National Society Development (NSD), BRC will also allocate funding for sustainable organizational development, particularly for stronger safeguarding mechanisms.
